title: ATMA: Long-Context Language Modeling via Polar Attention and Gated-Delta Compression Memory
abstract: arXiv:2606.25156v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Length extrapolation in language models involves competing objectives: retrieval fidelity, long-document likelihood, short-context quality, and inference cost. We present ATMA, a 378M-parameter hybrid recipe that combines Polar Attention with gated-delta recurrent memory, and study these objectives as a Pareto problem rather than claiming general architectural dominance. Polar Attention separates a normalized direction channel from a bounded participation-ratio magnitude channel. We select the recipe with a complete 120-cell, 1B-token factorial sweep, then train matched NoPE, RoPE, and Polar variants for 9.816B tokens at length 2K and evaluate them through 256K. Across the factorial, memory improves Polar's 64K retrieval score in all 20 matched cells (mean +47.8 points), whereas its effect on NoPE is small and inconsistent. At 256K, Polar retains 34.4% teacher-forced target-token accuracy and 9.0% exact five-token accuracy; exa

translated_title: ATMA：通过极性注意力和门控-德尔塔压缩记忆实现长上下文语言建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.25156v4 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：语言模型中的长度外推涉及相互竞争的目标：检索保真度、长文档似然度、短上下文质量和推理成本。我们提出了ATMA，一个378M参数的混合方案，结合了极性注意力与门控-德尔塔循环记忆，并将这些目标视为帕累托问题来研究，而非声称一般的架构优势。极性注意力将归一化的方向通道与有界的参与比幅度通道分开。我们通过完整的120单元、1B令牌阶乘扫描选择方案，然后训练匹配的NoPE、RoPE和极性变体，在长度2K下进行9.816B令牌训练，并评估至256K。在整个阶乘中，记忆在所有20个匹配单元中改善了极性的64K检索分数（平均+47.8分），而其对NoPE的影响则小而多变。在256K时，极性保留了34.4%的教师强制目标令牌准确率和9.0%的精确五令牌准确率；exa...
tldr: 本文提出ATMA混合模型，通过极性注意力与门控-德尔塔记忆结合，在长上下文外推中显著提升检索性能，并以帕累托视角权衡多目标。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ATMA, a hybrid model combining polar attention with gated-delta memory, significantly improving retrieval performance in long-context extrapolation while balancing multiple objectives from a Pareto perspective.
